Senses.Explanation: Breaking up the household and scattering the home is the destructive half of a paired Chan household image. The records contrast Zhaozhou’s phrase with Nanquan’s “making a living,” then ask whether either can stand alone. Guanghui Yuanlian and Shen Ding compare Zhaozhou with Nanquan; Puxian Yuansu weighs both household actions; Yuanwu says one requires the other; Ying’an and Chushi apply the image to later cases and public addresses.
